**Job Description**

**Title: Lead Data Engineer**

**Location: Any Ipsos Canada Location**

**Who We Are**

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And, we’re proud to share we’ve received our Great Place to Work Certification in 2024, for the third year running!

**ABOUT The Ipsos DataHub**

The Ipsos DataHub is a uniquely positioned group within Ipsos. It is a next-generation data platform designed to unlock the full value of data across the organization. By bringing together information, technology, and expertise in a seamless and secure ecosystem, it empowers teams to move faster, think bigger, and deliver deeper, more meaningful insights. DataHub is at the heart of Ipsos’ vision to transform how data drives decisions, innovation, and impact for clients worldwide.

We’re looking for someone with a deep interest and expertise in data engineering and the dedication to apply that passion. We need someone with the technical expertise to expand and optimize our existing data pipeline and architecture. The ideal candidate will have experience using cloud-based platforms, like Google Cloud Services and AWS, to build and maintain serverless data pipelines to efficiently process and warehouse large scale datasets. The role also requires conscientious attention to detail, an ability to work well on a small team, and a self-starter approach to problem solving and debugging.

**What You Can Expect To Be Doing**

- Lead the architecture, design, coding, testing, and delivery of cloud-based data pipelines and platform components that process and store large-scale datasets.
- Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, and technical guardrails for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, and serving.
- Design and optimize data warehouses and distributed data systems for scalability, security, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
- Provide hands-on technical leadership through solution design, code reviews, debugging, production support, and mentorship of data engineers.
- Own production readiness and reliability practices for the data platform, including service-level indicators/objectives (SLIs/SLOs), observability, monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and failure-mode analysis.
- Lead incident response for data-platform and pipeline disruptions; drive root-cause analysis, blameless post-incident reviews, and corrective actions that reduce recurrence and operational toil.
- Improve software delivery and operations through automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, runbooks, release controls, and operational tooling.
- Drive the migration of development code into production and ensure systems are supportable, maintainable, well-documented, and production-grade.
- Partner with internal and external stakeholders to translate business and project needs into technical architecture, delivery plans, and clear trade-off decisions.
- Continuously troubleshoot and improve existing infrastructure and codebases, and responsibly incorporate AI/LLM-based tools where they improve engineering productivity and quality.

**This might be the job for you if you have:**

- 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or a closely related field, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems.
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field required; master’s degree or higher preferred.
- Proficiency in Python and advanced working knowledge of SQL.
- Strong hands-on experience with GCP services, including BigQuery and GCS; familiarity with other cloud platforms is an asset.
- Hands-on SRE or production-engineering experience, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, monitoring and alerting, incident response, post-incident reviews, reliability automation, and operational readiness.
- Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices; experience with tools such as Terraform is preferred.
- Prior success designing, deploying, and operating large-scale data pipelines and distributed storage/compute systems in production environments.
- Strong understanding of production failure modes, performance tuning, capacity planning, data quality, and disaster-recovery/recoverability concepts.
- Experience with collaboration tools (e.g. Atlassian suite) and version control systems (e.g. Git).
- Experience incorporating AI/LLM-based tools into data engineering workflows, with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate outputs and apply sound engineering judgment to accept, adapt, or reject suggestions.
- Strong technical communication skills and the ability to explain complex engineering concepts, influence technical decisions, and work effectively in a highly collaborative, consensus-oriented environment.
- Strong attention to detail, excellent time-management skills, and a track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.

*In accordance with Ontario & British Columbia law, the estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $140,000 CAD. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discrimatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications.*

*If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to!*

**What’s In It For You**

*At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture.*

*To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit:*
*Why Work at Ipsos | CA*

**Inclusive Workplace Commitment**

Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. For more than 40 years, our mission has been to generate and analyze data about society, markets, brands, and behaviors to provide our clients with the insights that elevate their understanding of the world. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees, creating an environment that promotes inclusion, and enabling employees from all walks of life to flourish. Ipsos encourages our employees to act in a respectful and responsible manner, in line with code of best practices concerning diversity and inclusion, human rights, equality, and civility for every individual.

Ipsos is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other protected class and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

**About Jesta I.S.**

Jesta I.S. is a Canadian enterprise software company with over 55 years of experience delivering mission-critical solutions to retailers, wholesalers, and brand manufacturers worldwide. Our Vision Suite platform supports complex retail operations across merchandising, supply chain, inventory, commerce, and financial management. As part of our strategic investment in artificial intelligence, Jesta is developing intelligent enterprise applications that combine predictive analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI. Our AI Center of Excellence builds production-ready AI solutions that address real business challenges using enterprise data.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong applied machine learning expertise, hands-on production experience, and the ability to independently deliver complex AI initiatives. In this senior individual contributor role, you will take ownership of maintaining, improving, and scaling existing production AI models and pipelines while contributing to new predictive modeling and Generative AI capabilities. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and MLOps teams to develop reliable, scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling**

- Design, develop, and optimize ML models for demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and operational analytics.
- Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, statistical testing, and model evaluation.
- Evaluate forecasting and ML approaches based on accuracy, performance, and business impact.
- Continuously improve existing models using real-world enterprise data.

**Production AI & MLOps**

- Own the lifecycle of production ML models, including deployment, monitoring, optimization, and retraining.
- Identify and resolve model performance issues, data quality concerns, and scalability challenges.
- Collaborate with engineering teams on automated pipelines, CI/CD, model versioning, and deployment.
- Ensure production solutions meet reliability, security, and performance standards.

**Generative AI & LLM Applications**

- Develop and integrate LLM-powered applications using RAG, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
- Connect AI capabilities securely to enterprise data and applications.
- Evaluate commercial and open-source models for enterprise use cases.
- Contribute to the development of agentic AI and intelligent automation capabilities.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

- Independently scope, design, and deliver complex AI initiatives.
- Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide technical guidance through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
- Maintain technical documentation and apply responsible AI principles.

  

**Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications**

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in applied data science, including significant experience with production ML systems.
- Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining ML models in commercial environments.
- Advanced Python skills and experience with common ML libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, LightGBM, or XGBoost.
- Strong statistical foundations, predictive modeling, experimentation, and model evaluation skills.
- Hands-on experience developing applications using LLMs or Generative AI.
- Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex datasets.
- Familiarity with MLOps practices, model monitoring, experiment tracking, and deployment pipelines.
- Demonstrated technical autonomy, problem-solving skills, and ability to collaborate across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with demand forecasting, time-series modeling, or inventory optimization.
- Experience with AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, MLflow, Docker, or CI/CD pipelines.
- Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
- Exposure to agentic AI, tool calling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Experience with computer vision or multimodal AI.
- Knowledge of ERP systems, retail data, or supply chain analytics.
- Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, AI, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.

  

**Why Join Jesta?**

  

- Work on production AI solutions integrated into enterprise applications.
- Take meaningful ownership of ML models and pipelines used by real clients.
- Contribute to projects combining predictive analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI.
- Solve complex retail and supply chain challenges using enterprise data.
- Collaborate with experienced technical teams while maintaining significant autonomy.

  

**Location:** Montreal, Quebec. Hybrid work arrangement requiring two days per week in the Montreal office.

**À propos de Jesta I.S.**

Jesta I.S. est une entreprise canadienne spécialisée dans les logiciels d'entreprise, qui accompagne depuis plus de 55 ans les détaillants, grossistes et fabricants de marques à travers le monde. Notre plateforme Vision Suite soutient les opérations complexes du commerce de détail, notamment le marchandisage, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la gestion des stocks, le commerce et la gestion financière. Dans le cadre de notre investissement stratégique en intelligence artificielle, Jesta développe des applications d'entreprise intelligentes intégrant l'analyse prédictive, l'apprentissage automatique, l'IA générative et l'IA agentique. Notre Centre d'excellence en IA conçoit des solutions d'IA déployées en production qui répondent à des besoins d'affaires concrets.

**Votre rôle**

Nous recherchons une personne expérimentée en science des données possédant une solide expertise en apprentissage automatique, une expérience concrète des environnements de production et la capacité de mener des initiatives complexes de façon autonome. À titre de **Scientifique de données senior**, vous serez responsable de la maintenance, de l'amélioration et de la mise à l'échelle des modèles et pipelines d'IA existants, tout en contribuant au développement de nouvelles capacités en modélisation prédictive et en IA générative. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes d'ingénierie des données, de développement logiciel et de MLOps afin de concevoir des solutions d'IA fiables, évolutives et créatrices de valeur.

**Principales responsabilités**

**Apprentissage automatique et modélisation prédictive**

- Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles d'apprentissage automatique pour la prévision de la demande, l'optimisation des stocks et l'analyse opérationnelle.
- Réaliser des analyses exploratoires, de l'ingénierie de variables, des tests statistiques et des évaluations de modèles.
- Comparer différentes approches de modélisation selon leur précision, leur performance et leur valeur d'affaires.
- Améliorer continuellement les modèles existants à partir de données d'entreprise réelles.

**IA en production et MLOps**

- Assurer la gestion du cycle de vie des modèles en production : déploiement, surveillance, optimisation et réentraînement.
- Identifier et résoudre les problèmes de performance, de qualité des données et d'évolutivité.
- Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie sur l'automatisation des pipelines, le CI/CD, le versionnement et le déploiement.
- Veiller à la fiabilité, à la sécurité et à la performance des solutions déployées.

**IA générative et grands modèles de langage (LLM)**

- Développer et intégrer des applications utilisant les LLM, notamment les architectures RAG, l'ingénierie de requêtes, les sorties structurées et l'évaluation des modèles.
- Connecter les capacités d'IA aux données et applications d'entreprise de manière sécurisée.
- Évaluer les modèles commerciaux et à code source ouvert pour différents cas d'utilisation.
- Contribuer au développement de solutions d'IA agentique et d'automatisation intelligente.

**Leadership technique et collaboration**

- Définir, concevoir et réaliser de manière autonome des initiatives complexes en IA.
- Traduire les besoins d'affaires en solutions techniques robustes et évolutives.
- Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et contribuer aux revues de code et au partage des connaissances.
- Maintenir une documentation technique claire et appliquer les principes d'une IA responsable.

  

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications essentielles**

- Minimum de **5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en science des données appliquée**, incluant une expérience significative avec des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique en production.
- Expérience démontrée dans le développement, le déploiement et la maintenance de modèles d'apprentissage automatique en environnement commercial.
- Excellente maîtrise de Python et des bibliothèques courantes telles que scikit-learn, PyTorch, LightGBM ou XGBoost.
- Solides connaissances en statistiques, modélisation prédictive, expérimentation et évaluation de modèles.
- Expérience pratique dans le développement d'applications utilisant les LLM ou l'IA générative.
- Bonne maîtrise de SQL et expérience avec des ensembles de données complexes.
- Connaissance des pratiques de MLOps, de surveillance des modèles, de suivi des expérimentations et des pipelines de déploiement.
- Grande autonomie technique, excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes et aptitude à collaborer avec différentes équipes.

**Qualifications souhaitées**

- Expérience en prévision de la demande, modélisation de séries temporelles ou optimisation des stocks.
- Expérience avec AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, MLflow, Docker ou les pipelines CI/CD.
- Connaissance des architectures RAG, des bases de données vectorielles et des outils d'orchestration des LLM.
- Familiarité avec l'IA agentique, l'appel d'outils ou le Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Expérience en vision par ordinateur ou en IA multimodale.
- Connaissance des systèmes ERP, des données du commerce de détail ou de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
- Maîtrise ou doctorat en science des données, intelligence artificielle, informatique, statistiques ou discipline connexe.

  

**Pourquoi vous joindre à Jesta?**

  

- Travailler sur des solutions d'IA intégrées à des applications d'entreprise en production.
- Assumer une responsabilité technique importante sur des modèles et pipelines utilisés par de véritables clients.
- Contribuer à des projets combinant analyse prédictive, apprentissage automatique et IA générative.
- Résoudre des problèmes complexes liés au commerce de détail et à la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
- Collaborer avec des équipes techniques expérimentées tout en bénéficiant d'une grande autonomie.

  

**L****ieu de travail :** Montréal, Québec. Mode hybride avec une présence requise au bureau deux jours par semaine.

**About The Role**
Shopify's mission is Making Commerce Better for Everyone, and in this role you'll use data to show the world exactly how we're doing just that. This team puts the numbers behind Shopify's narrative: how our merchants power the broader economy, the cultural shifts in what people are purchasing, and the milestones merchants reach.
  
  
**The problem**
Every number this team ships gets quoted by journalists, read by policymakers and checked by anyone who wants to. It has to be right, it has to survive a lawyer, and it has to be worth remembering, often on a live deadline. Nobody hands you a spec for that. You decide which questions are worth answering, build what it takes to answer them, and own the number once it is public. External Insights is part of Executive Insights, so you'll work alongside the team that tracks and interprets Shopify's core metrics.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

- Own the numbers end to end. Frame the question before you touch the data, then compute, pressure test and keep the record of every stat we publish. A wrong number is wrong in public.
- Tell the story behind the data. Turn a headline stat, a breakout trend or a full data feature into something people remember.
- Run the data side of Black Friday Cyber Monday. It's our Super Bowl: get the metrics showtime ready, run the live pulls, and have the story ready however the weekend lands.
- Give policymakers the facts. Build the local merchant data and self-serve tools that government affairs can use without waiting on you.
- Build with AI as a reflex. Use it to iterate faster and automate workflows, and check what it produces, so your taste and judgement set the work apart.
- Show the world how Shopify does data. Help people outside Shopify see what data work looks like at this scale.
- Lift the craft. Mentor others and leave the team better than you found it.

**What You'll Bring**

- You write SQL and Python fluently and have shipped data products people still rely on.
- You can walk us from the raw data to the decision it changed.
- You're at home with forecasting and statistics, and can build an index or an economic impact model.
- You can explain a method in one sentence a journalist would quote and a lawyer would approve, and you'll say when a number doesn't hold.
- You stay cool under real deadlines.
- You've led projects across teams without a PM and owned the outcome.
- You use AI in your daily work and can say what it changed for you and where it got things wrong.
- You get a little too excited about a weird trend in the data, and you question the metric before you report it.

**Bonus points**

- Your numbers have been published: press, reports, filings or policy briefs.
- You've worked with IR or Legal, or inside a public company's disclosure process.
- You speak macro: GDP, trade, currencies.
- You've been the first or only data person somewhere and built the measurement from scratch.
- You share your work in public: writing, talks or open analyses.

**Show Us What You've Built**
When you apply, point us to something you made: a published analysis, a data product, a tool, a repo or a piece of writing. We care more about what you've built than where you've worked.
  
  
**About Shopify**
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
  
  
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.
  
  
**About You**
Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
  
  
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  
  

- Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
- Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
- Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
- Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
- Bring critical thought and opinion
- Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
- Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
- Work digital-first for your daily work

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

### 

### The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

  

This role is in Early Development Biometrics (EDB), a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across early clinical development at Roche. We partner across Biostatistics, Analytical Data Science, and Data Management to enable data-driven decision-making from first-in-human through proof-of-concept studies.

  

As trusted partners in early development, we design efficient and innovative clinical trials, apply rigorous statistical methods, and implement high-quality programming and analytical solutions to accelerate timelines, de-risk development, and increase the probability of technical success. Our integrated teams operate with agility and scientific depth, supporting exploratory analyses, early regulatory engagements, and complex data-generation needs across therapeutic areas.

Together, we bring scientific rigor, technical innovation, and strategic insight to shape the future of early development and deliver better outcomes for patients.

  

**The Opportunity:**

  

The Early Development ADS Programmer develops high-quality, analysis-ready datasets and outputs that enable exploratory evidence generation in early-phase clinical trials. This role supports flexible and evolving study needs by creating custom data structures, outputs, and visualizations suited to novel or non-standard endpoints. Working within defined statistical analysis plans and programming conventions, the programmer ensures traceability, reproducibility, and technical rigor across diverse data sources. With strong proficiency in

statistical programming and an understanding of early development challenges, this role helps deliver timely, fit-for-purpose outputs that inform development decisions and support transition into later-phase studies.

  

● You support the development and validation of exploratory datasets and outputs for early phase clinical studies, including custom data structures and visualizations, based on protocol and analysis requirements

● You generate programming deliverables (e.g., datasets, summary outputs, visual displays) using validated tools and standard code libraries, with guidance from more experienced programmers

● You contribute to documentation and quality control practices to ensure transparency, reproducibility, and consistency in early development outputs

● You identify and resolve basic technical issues in code or output by performing structured checks and escalating as needed

● You learn and apply foundational concepts in early development programming, including flexible data design, data traceability, and fit for purpose output generation

● You engage in learning activities to deepen understanding of early clinical research, exploratory endpoints, and evolving data standards relevant to early phase development

● You work under general supervision and apply independent judgment to interpret guidance, prioritize responsibilities, and make decisions in situations that require contextual understanding

**Who You Are:**

  

● You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or a related field

● You bring relevant experience in statistical programming, or an advanced degree with equivalent work experience

● You have basic proficiency in a modern programming language (e.g., SAS, R, or Python) for data manipulation and output generation

● You understand data integrity principles and quality control processes in a scientific setting

● You work effectively with structured and semi structured data in support of scientific exploration

● You are curious and willing to learn the unique analytical needs of early clinical development

● You show strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and effective written documentation practices

● You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

**Preferred:**

● Familiarity with handling non-standard or exploratory clinical data, such as biomarkers, - omics, or real-world data

● Exposure to data visualization techniques and tools (e.g., ggplot2, plotly, SAS Graph, Shiny)

● Awareness of early development study designs and their implications for data structure and analysis

● Familiarity with data traceability, metadata documentation, or audit readiness practices

● Interest in programming for decision support, hypothesis generation, or translational insight

● Ability to follow and contribute to reproducible programming workflows (e.g., version control, notebooks, modular scripts)

● Demonstrated initiative in learning new tools or contributing to process improvement

● Experience supporting early-phase clinical trials, including familiarity with adaptive designs, rapid data cycles, and evolving endpoints typical of exploratory and translational research

**Location**

● This position is based in Welwyn/Mississauga

● Relocation Assistance is not available

  
  
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
